---
title: "Git on Start + Void"
description: "Cutover packet for the native Git Worker: names, bindings, build, smoke checks and rollback to Vercel."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

`apps/git` runs natively on TanStack Start + Vite+ + Void on `main`, beside its Next build.
`vercel-production-git.yaml` still deploys the Next app, so the current Vercel deployment
keeps serving until the route is flipped.

## Worker

- Worker: `tuturuuu-git` (`workers_dev` and `preview_urls` off, `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX=1` until the cutover PR sets the production value). Nothing here attaches a route.
- Entry: `apps/git/cloudflare/worker.ts`; Wrangler config is emitted by `void` into `dist`.
- Host: `git.tuturuuu.com`. Root-only: `mountHosts` is empty and `unknownHost` is `reject`, so `tuturuuu.com/git` and any other host answer 404 before app code runs.
- Binding: `ASSETS` (static output, `run_worker_first`).
- Variables (names): `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX`, optional `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` (default `https://tuturuuu.com`).
- Secrets (names, set in the Worker, never in the repo): `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`,
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY`,
  `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`. Compare with the Vercel project environment list
  before the flip.

## Build and qualification

```bash
bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
bun turbo:local run build --filter=@tuturuuu/git^... --concurrency=2
bun scripts/ci/generate-build-metadata.ts
bun run --cwd apps/git build:cloudflare
bun run --cwd apps/git routes:check
bun run --cwd apps/git type-check:cloudflare
CI=true CI_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) bun run --cwd apps/git test:runtime
```

`git-cloudflare.yaml` runs the same steps, records the emitted config receipt and packages
`dist` with the receipt. `cloudflare/anonymous.runtime.mjs` starts the emitted Worker in
workerd: the canonical host answers the public root (a redirect to `/tutur3u/platform`, or
`200`), an unknown host answers `404`, and closed public ingress such as
`/api/storage/probe` answers `403`.

## Smoke checks after the route is attached

```bash
curl -sI https://git.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info          # 200, JSON, no-store
curl -sI https://git.tuturuuu.com/                        # redirect to /tutur3u/platform
curl -sI https://git.tuturuuu.com/tutur3u/platform        # 200, renders
curl -sI https://git.tuturuuu.com/api/storage/probe       # 403, ingress closed
curl -sI https://tuturuuu.com/git                         # 404 (root-only app)
```

No smoke request may return `5xx`.

## Rollback

1. Before the flip, record the current production Vercel deployment id (the repo does not
   store it) and the DNS records and TTLs for `git.tuturuuu.com` in the release record.
2. Roll back by detaching the Worker route or restoring the captured DNS records to the
   recorded deployment. `vercel-production-git.yaml` still deploys the Next app.
3. Rerun the smoke checks against the Vercel origin.

Rolling back touches no database rows and no migrations. Route, DNS and deployment
changes belong to the release owner.
